title: Javi Pérez — Independent Legal-Cost Researcher
description: Javi Pérez writes and maintains LegalCostGuides. He is not a lawyer; his work is sourcing U.S. legal fees and rules from official documents.
body:
Independent legal-cost researcherAlmería, Spain · javiperezguides@gmail.com · LinkedIn

What I do on this site

I research, write and maintain every page on LegalCostGuides. My background is in IT and content operations, not law: I am not an attorney or a paralegal, and nothing I publish is legal advice. My work is the sourcing: reading court fee schedules, statutes, agency fee pages and published rate surveys, and turning them into plain-English explanations with a link to each source.

How I work

  • Every dollar figure, percentage or deadline is cited at the claim, or shown as a labeled example with its arithmetic.
  • When I cannot verify a fee, the page says "not verified" rather than guessing.
  • Litigation status pages are dated and re-checked; nothing on the site predicts what a case is worth.
  • Commercial relationships (AdSense, LawDepot affiliate links, our own planning kits) are disclosed where they appear and on the disclosure page.

If you find an error, email me with the source and I will check it.
